description.en: Clears a look-at override previously set with CMND_SET_LOOK_AT, letting the character's head/eyes stop tracking the target.
True once the look-at override was cleared; null if the call was invalid (no handle given) or the handle doesn't resolve to an existing character.

example.code:
// Stop a character from tracking its look-at target
CMND_RESET_LOOK_AT(hAoiL);
